description: Santa Clara County (FIPS 06085) assessor secured roll for the FactLot Registry collector. NOT VERIFIED: the roll is sold, not published. Review record: docs/registry/sources/ca-santa-clara-assessor.md.

sources.publisher: County of Santa Clara, Office of the Assessor
sources.license: Not a free file. The Assessor sells the Secured Master File (owner names, land and improvement values, exemptions, tax rate areas; with or without Use Codes) on a paid order form. Licence and redistribution terms are in the order form and were not readable (see notes)
sources.redistribution: Unknown: terms not read; the Assessor's own web portal is described as view-and-print only
sources.notes: GATES: purchase (price on a dated order form; 2016 schedule listed $2,485 with Use Codes and $495 without, 2021 form says prices change yearly and to call 408-299-5500 for the current form), a written order form with a cheque payable to the Santa Clara County Assessor, and resale/redistribution conditions not yet read. The Assessor site (asr.santaclaracounty.gov, formerly sccassessor.org) answers automated requests with a Cloudflare 'Attention Required' challenge or HTTP 403, including to a plain browser-less fetch; the collector does not attempt to get past it, so no terms text was read directly. Free alternative reviewed: the county GIS hub layer 'Parcels' (maps.santaclaracounty.gov/server/rest/services/opendata/SCCGISHUB/MapServer/116, 504,722 features) has only APN, tax rate area and situs address fields: no use code, no owner, no values, so it cannot yield commercial-scope records.
